title: Exponential Lyapunov bridge from a source compensator to N2c/N4
purpose: Isolate the exact pathwise estimate that would turn the source-owned static C2(A) bound into compact-time boundary escape and non-explosion. This is an implication contract; it does not invent a PAH process, rate, carrier, or comparison map.

frozen_scope.model: Exactly PAH-001 F_rho, original directed PH/LK/AP/TR rates, labelled Gibbs state, OMC-010 path, and j-before-anchored-n order.
frozen_scope.observable: A fixed bounded local cylinder with finite initial influence size w and boundary overlap distance d_m.
frozen_scope.time: External stochastic Markov time on a compact interval [0,T]; no quantum, proper, or Lorentzian interpretation.
frozen_scope.comparison: No U_n, conditional generator averaging, direct sum, new carrier, counterterm, rate fitting, or state replacement is introduced.
frozen_scope.input: R-522 C2(A)<=60|A| is used only as a static coefficient in the final N4 budget.

required_owner_packet.predictable_lyapunov: For b>1 and V(z)=b^z, a source-authorized path law must provide a predictable compensator or stopped supermartingale estimate E[V(Z_(t intersect tau_d))] <= M_T V(Z_0), uniformly in n and the retained regulators.
required_owner_packet.boundary_hitting: The influence process must have tau_d=inf{t: Z_t>=d} and the non-explosion exhaustion tau_infty=lim_(d->infinity) tau_d on the same filtration.
required_owner_packet.N4_attribution: The source packet must prove eta_(m,T)^2 <= C2(A) P(tau_(d_m)<=T) for the actual A_n^(out,m) Q_n(s)g term, without replacing the original rates.
required_owner_packet.minimal_form: The resulting process/form must still be identified with the R-512 minimal closed form; this bridge does not supply that identification.

conditional_theorem.probability: If E[V(Z_(T intersect tau_d))] <= M_T b^w and V>=b^d on {tau_d<=T}, then P(tau_d<=T) <= M_T*b^w/b^d.
conditional_theorem.non_explosion: If tau_d increases to tau_infty, the bound tends to zero for b>1, so P(tau_infty<=T)=0 under the supplied path-law hypotheses.
conditional_theorem.boundary: If eta_(m,T)^2 <= C2(A)P(tau_(d_m)<=T), then eta_(m,T)^2 <= C2(A)M_T*b^w/b^(d_m), which vanishes as d_m->infinity.
conditional_theorem.constant: For the registered PAH support, C2(A) may be instantiated by the source bound 60|A|; no claim is made for a random or growing support without the owner packet.

finite_fixture.role: Exact rational test inputs only; they are not PAH constants or an infinite-volume estimate.

decision_rule.MAINLINE_ADVANCE: Only after a source-authorized compensator/path law, N4 attribution, N2b/N2d comparison, and independent verification are all supplied.
decision_rule.NEGATIVE_RESULT: Only an exact PAH-specific contradiction to the required pathwise estimate qualifies; an absent repository packet is not a universal no-go.
decision_rule.HOLD_FOR_EVIDENCE: The present contract remains conditional while the owner packet and the actual eta-to-hitting-event attribution are missing.

single_next_question: Can a source owner provide the stopped exponential-Lyapunov compensator and the exact eta_(m,T)^2-to-hitting-event attribution for the unchanged PAH-001 process?
revisit_condition: Reopen only when every required owner field is versioned and hash-pinned, or when an exact PAH-specific contradiction to the conditional theorem is found. Do not repeat finite carrier or physical-empty calculations.
non_claims: No source-authorized path-space law, non-explosion theorem, N2b liminf/recovery, N2c/N4 boundary escape, N2d minimal-form identification, or PAH-OMC-020 semigroup convergence.
No universal impossibility follows from the missing owner packet or from the rational fixtures.
No PAH-001 functional, rate, state, carrier, regulator, normalization, external Markov time, or limit order is changed.
No physical Pre-A, spacetime, event horizon, QFT, gravity, Yang-Mills, continuum, mass-gap, or TOE conclusion.
